requirements.value: Python 3.11+ and the pinned packages in requirements.txt. The local package includes all required Python helpers and referenced reader assets; install dependencies in a separate environment.

Use scripts/run_daily_brief.py with an absolute private output directory outside the installed skill. Historical data is intentionally excluded and generated on first run; do not write bytecode, logs or private configuration into the package.

Normal generation needs authorized public-feed access; source availability and rate limits are external. Optional email/X/cookie/paid APIs require separate private host/vault configuration, explicit authorization and applicable service fees. No live/authenticated test is implied by fixture smoke results.

The optional bundled reader references the separately licensed GSAP 3.13.0 script on jsDelivr. Optional persona scoring can run rules-only with PERSONA_ENABLED=0; authenticated DeepSeek calls require separate explicit approval, private DEEPSEEK_API_KEY configuration and applicable fees. Neither is a prerequisite for the daily-brief JSON generator.
